label: 2010-11 Horn of Africa drought
evidence: Both the Oct-Dec 2010 short rains and the Mar-May 2011 long rains failed
source_title: NOAA Climate.gov: Two Failed Rainy Seasons Lead to Drought in Horn of Africa

label: 2016-17 drought (national disaster declared Feb 2017)
evidence: Late, brief and inadequate Oct-Dec 2016 short rains; drought declared a national disaster on 9-10 Feb 2017
source_title: World Weather Attribution: Severe drought in Kenya, 2016-17

label: 2020-21 drought (national disaster declared Sep 2021)
evidence: Three consecutive below-average rainy seasons beginning with Oct-Dec 2020; declared a national disaster on 8 Sep 2021
source_title: ACAPS Thematic report: Kenya - Impact of drought (31 Mar 2022)

label: 2000 long rains failure (worst drought in 37 years)
evidence: FAO: the 2000 Mar-May long rains failed due to severe drought; heaviest losses in northern and north-eastern pastoral areas
source_title: FAO GIEWS Foodcrops & Shortages: Kenya (18 Sep 2000)
listed: after indicator flagged it; verified independently

label: 2005-06 drought (national disaster declared Jan 2006)
evidence: Short rains failed in northern and eastern Kenya; national disaster declared in 8 northern and north-eastern districts on 2 Jan 2006
listed: after indicator flagged it; verified independently

label: 1997 El Nino short rains
evidence: The 2019 short rains were among the wettest since 1985, surpassed only by 1997
source_title: Wainwright et al. (2020), Weather: the exceptional 2019 short rains

label: 2019 short rains floods (strong positive IOD)
evidence: Heavy rain since early October affected over 100000 people and caused at least 29 deaths by 30 Oct 2019
source_title: UN OCHA Kenya Flash Update #1: Floods (30 Oct 2019)

label: 2023 El Nino floods (Garissa / Mandera / Wajir most affected)
evidence: By 20 Nov 2023 at least 60 deaths and 135125 displaced; Garissa, Mandera and Wajir most affected

label: 2024 long rains floods
evidence: 315 people killed by heavy rains and floods between 1 Mar and 29 May 2024
source_title: UN OCHA Eastern Africa Heavy Rains and Flooding Flash Update #4 (30 May 2024)

label: 2023 long rains flash floods in northern counties
evidence: Flash floods in Marsabit, Mandera, Garissa, Isiolo, Samburu and Wajir in late March-April 2023; northern pastoral rains over twice the long-term average
source_title: Kenya Red Cross / IFRC DREF operation MDRKE056 (floods, 2023)
listed: after indicator flagged it; verified independently
